title: env.boot.info result
description: The boot block's tag, checksum, root block, and whether it carries code.

tag.description: The three-character tag, as text. DOS for an AmigaDOS disk.

flags.description: The fourth tag byte: the filesystem flags.

is_dos.description: Whether the tag is DOS. A disk that is not is usually a trackloader.

stored_checksum.description: The checksum as stored. Reported beside whether it verifies rather than as a pass or a fail: a custom-boot disk with a deliberately wrong checksum is a normal thing to find, and a result that only said invalid would lose the number that recognizes it.

has_boot_code.description: Whether the boot code area holds anything but zeroes.
